panelTitle: Who can do what on Employees
ariaLabel: Open help: permissions on the Employees page

sections.heading: Admin
bullets: Add new employees using the Employee button in the top-right.
Grant or revoke the Admin role on any Employee or Admin row.
Revoke Admin is disabled on your own row — you cannot remove your own admin access.
Promote an employee to IT Ops or revoke IT Ops access from this list.
Use Filters to narrow the list by department or role.

sections.heading: IT Ops
bullets: Grant or revoke the Admin role on Employee and Admin rows.
Promote employees to IT Ops or revoke IT Ops access.
Cannot add or create new employees — that requires Admin access.
Role actions are disabled on your own row so you cannot demote yourself.

sections.heading: Employee
bullets: Read-only access — employee records are visible but cannot be created or modified.
